title: typed observation admission policy as a logical query code
hypothesis: A small per-query admission code can select one of 32 independent private sensors for eight logical queries, reducing transmitted messages and policy bytes versus centralized all-observation inference, while native type-based routing remains a required mirror-specific control.
physical_object: Thirty-two private scalar observation agents, four redundant agents per latent coordinate
mirror_coordinate: One uint8 agent address per query, stored in an eight-query policy table
logical_multiplicity: Eight coordinate-query functions served by one shared private-agent population
controls: centralized exact posterior using all 32 typed observations

development.selection_metric: no hyperparameter selection; fixed one-agent budget and fixed reliability schedule

world.sensor_types: 4 agents per coordinate; fixed noise standard deviations [0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0] within each coordinate
world.messages: only agent id, declared coordinate type, and one float32 noisy observation; no weights, gradients, hidden states, or policy internals are shared
world.queries: one target coordinate per query, eight total

inference.centralized: Gaussian posterior mean from all four observations per queried coordinate
inference.single_agent: best or random admitted agent; posterior mean using its public noise class
inference.latency: one-hop star-to-aggregator topology, report messages and hop count explicitly

storage.authority: actual serialized policy bytes and actual encoded message bytes
storage.private_model_state: agents retain their private measurement process; no model state is serialized into shared policy

success_gate: Single-agent policy uses at most 1/16 the centralized messages and actual message bytes, has heldout normalized MSE <=0.35, and stored policy is <=32 bytes; Mirror-specific gain additionally requires outperforming the native type/reliability rule with the same message budget.
failure_gate: Quality misses the fixed MSE gate, communication/policy bytes fail their gate, or Mirror address table exactly aliases native deterministic routing. Report the communication-quality tradeoff even on failure.
boundaries: This is a synthetic linear-Gaussian collective-inference screen, not a neural-network compression result.
Observation-only boundary is enforced: no agent weights, gradients, hidden states, or private policy are transmitted.
Logical query count does not equal independent model capacity.
The star topology gives a lower-bound latency screen; general mesh routing is untested.
